commands.name: tool.select
commands.label: Select
commands.description: Pick the select tool.

commands.name: tool.hand
commands.label: Hand
commands.description: Pick the hand tool: drag to pan the board.

commands.name: tool.rect
commands.label: Rectangle
commands.description: Pick the rectangle tool.

commands.name: tool.ellipse
commands.label: Ellipse
commands.description: Pick the ellipse tool.

commands.name: tool.diamond
commands.label: Diamond
commands.description: Pick the diamond tool.

commands.name: tool.triangle
commands.label: Triangle
commands.description: Pick the triangle tool.

commands.name: tool.arrow
commands.label: Arrow
commands.description: Pick the arrow tool: drag from one shape to another to connect them.

commands.name: tool.line
commands.label: Line
commands.description: Pick the line tool.

commands.name: tool.pen
commands.label: Pen
commands.description: Pick the pen: freehand ink with pressure.

commands.name: tool.highlighter
commands.label: Highlighter
commands.description: Pick the highlighter: wide translucent ink under the shapes.

commands.name: tool.eraser
commands.label: Eraser
commands.description: Pick the eraser: drag across strokes and shapes to delete them.

commands.name: tool.lasso
commands.label: Lasso
commands.description: Pick the lasso: draw round shapes to select them.

commands.name: tool.text
commands.label: Text
commands.description: Pick the text tool.

commands.name: tool.sticky
commands.label: Sticky note
commands.description: Pick the sticky note tool.

commands.name: tool.frame
commands.label: Frame
commands.description: Pick the frame tool: drag out a named area that holds what is inside it.

commands.name: tool.table
commands.label: Table
commands.description: Pick the table tool: click for a 3 by 3 table, or drag to size one.

commands.name: board.read
commands.label: Read board
commands.description: Read the board as a compact list: each shape's id, kind, bounds (x, y, w, h), text, frame and group, and for arrows the shape ids they join (from, to). Optional ids or region narrow it.

page.description: Page id (default: the page on screen)

commands.name: board.snapshot
commands.label: Snapshot
commands.description: A PNG of part of the board, for an agent to look at: the shapes `ids`, or a `region` box, or the whole board. maxSize caps the long edge in pixels (default 1024). Returns { dataUrl, width, height, region }.

commands.name: shape.add
commands.label: Add shape
commands.description: Add a shape: kind is rect, ellipse, diamond, triangle, line, arrow, text, sticky, frame, image or ink. Fields: x, y, w, h (board units, 1 = 1 CSS px at 100%), rotation (radians), text, stroke, fill (#rrggbb or transparent), strokeWidth (0–64), dash (solid|dashed|dotted), opacity (0–1), radius (corner radius), sketch (true: hand-drawn look), font (hand|sans|mono), fontSize (px; presets s 16, m 20, l 28, xl 36), align (left|center|right). Every shape has pageId (its page) and link (null or a frame id to jump to). Kind fields: sticky color (yellow|orange|pink|purple|blue|teal|green|gray); frame name and stack (null or { dir: row|column, gap, padding, align: start|center|end }); text autoWidth; line/arrow/ink points [[x,y],…] in board coordinates; arrow route (straight|curved|elbow), bend (curved: -2..2), startHead/endHead (none|arrow|triangle|dot|bar), tree (a mind-map link); ink highlight; image fileId and crop; stamp emoji; path d (SVG path data), viewBox [w, h], stencil (its library name); table cells [[text]], colWidths, rowHeights, headerRow. Returns { id }.

commands.name: shape.update
commands.label: Change shapes
commands.description: Change fields on shapes (default: the selection). Fields: x, y, w, h (board units, 1 = 1 CSS px at 100%), rotation (radians), text, stroke, fill (#rrggbb or transparent), strokeWidth (0–64), dash (solid|dashed|dotted), opacity (0–1), radius (corner radius), sketch (true: hand-drawn look), font (hand|sans|mono), fontSize (px; presets s 16, m 20, l 28, xl 36), align (left|center|right). Every shape has pageId (its page) and link (null or a frame id to jump to). Kind fields: sticky color (yellow|orange|pink|purple|blue|teal|green|gray); frame name and stack (null or { dir: row|column, gap, padding, align: start|center|end }); text autoWidth; line/arrow/ink points [[x,y],…] in board coordinates; arrow route (straight|curved|elbow), bend (curved: -2..2), startHead/endHead (none|arrow|triangle|dot|bar), tree (a mind-map link); ink highlight; image fileId and crop; stamp emoji; path d (SVG path data), viewBox [w, h], stencil (its library name); table cells [[text]], colWidths, rowHeights, headerRow.

commands.name: shape.delete
commands.label: Delete
commands.description: Delete shapes (default: the selection). A frame takes its contents; arrows bound to a deleted shape stay where they were drawn.

commands.name: shape.move
commands.label: Move
commands.description: Move shapes by dx, dy board units. A frame carries its contents; arrows bound to the shapes follow.

commands.name: shape.nudge_left
commands.label: Nudge _left
commands.description: Move the selection _left by `by` units (default 1; the keyboard uses 10 with Shift).

commands.name: shape.nudge_right
commands.label: Nudge _right
commands.description: Move the selection _right by `by` units (default 1; the keyboard uses 10 with Shift).

commands.name: shape.nudge_up
commands.label: Nudge _up
commands.description: Move the selection _up by `by` units (default 1; the keyboard uses 10 with Shift).

commands.name: shape.nudge_down
commands.label: Nudge _down
commands.description: Move the selection _down by `by` units (default 1; the keyboard uses 10 with Shift).

commands.name: shape.resize
commands.label: Resize
commands.description: Scale shapes so their combined bounds become the box `to` (from defaults to their current bounds). A negative w or h mirrors.

commands.name: shape.rotate
commands.label: Rotate
commands.description: Rotate shapes by `degrees` (clockwise) about their combined centre or a pivot [x, y].

commands.name: shape.flip_x
commands.label: Flip horizontal
commands.description: Mirror shapes left to right about their combined centre.

commands.name: shape.flip_y
commands.label: Flip vertical
commands.description: Mirror shapes top to bottom about their combined centre.

commands.name: shape.duplicate
commands.label: Duplicate
commands.description: Copy shapes (with their arrows between them) 16 units down and right. Returns { ids }.

commands.name: shape.lock
commands.label: Lock or unlock
commands.description: Lock shapes (they cannot be selected on the canvas, moved or changed) or unlock them. With no `locked`, toggles.

commands.name: shape.align
commands.label: Align
commands.description: Align shapes to the edges or centre of their combined bounds: how is left, centerX, right, top, centerY or bottom.

commands.name: shape.distribute
commands.label: Distribute
commands.description: Space three or more shapes evenly across (axis x) or down (axis y).

commands.name: order.forward
commands.label: Bring forward
commands.description: Bring forward: change the drawing order of shapes.

commands.name: order.backward
commands.label: Send backward
commands.description: Send backward: change the drawing order of shapes.

commands.name: order.front
commands.label: Bring to front
commands.description: Bring to front: change the drawing order of shapes.

commands.name: order.back
commands.label: Send to back
commands.description: Send to back: change the drawing order of shapes.

commands.name: group.create
commands.label: Group
commands.description: Group two or more shapes so they select and move together. Returns { id } (the group id).

commands.name: group.remove
commands.label: Ungroup
commands.description: Take shapes out of their outermost group.

commands.name: arrow.connect
commands.label: Connect
commands.description: Draw an arrow from shape `from` to shape `to`, bound at both ends, so it follows them when they move, resize or undo. Optional: route (straight|curved|elbow), startHead/endHead (none|arrow|triangle|dot|bar), text (a label), startAnchor/endAnchor ([ax, ay], fractions of the shape box, to pin an end to a fixed point). Returns { id }.

commands.name: arrow.bind
commands.label: Attach arrow end
commands.description: Bind one end (start or end) of an arrow to a shape. mode edge (default) meets the outline; mode fixed pins it to anchor [ax, ay] (fractions of the shape box).

commands.name: arrow.unbind
commands.label: Detach arrow end
commands.description: Let go of one end of an arrow; it stays where it is drawn.

commands.name: arrow.set_end
commands.label: Move arrow end
commands.description: Put one end of an arrow or line at a board point, releasing any binding on that end.

commands.name: frame.create
commands.label: Frame selection
commands.description: Make a named frame around shapes (default: the selection), holding them; or, with a box and no shapes, an empty frame. Returns { id }.

commands.name: edit.undo
commands.label: Undo
commands.description: Undo the last edit (a whole drag or script is one step).

commands.name: edit.redo
commands.label: Redo
commands.description: Redo the last undone edit.

commands.name: edit.copy
commands.label: Copy
commands.description: Copy the selection (also as Excalidraw-compatible JSON).

commands.name: edit.cut
commands.label: Cut
commands.description: Copy the selection, then delete it.

commands.name: edit.paste
commands.label: Paste
commands.description: Paste shapes (Chartella or Excalidraw clipboard), an image or text at the pointer.

commands.name: edit.paste_in_place
commands.label: Paste in place
commands.description: Paste shapes at the place they were copied from.

commands.name: edit.select_all
commands.label: Select all
commands.description: Select every unlocked shape.

commands.name: edit.select
commands.label: Select shapes
commands.description: Select shapes by id (an empty list clears the selection).

commands.name: image.insert
commands.label: Insert image
commands.description: Place an image: from a data URL (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, SVG), or with no dataUrl open a file picker. It is downscaled to 2048 px on the long edge and stored once by content hash. Returns { id }.

commands.name: board.set
commands.label: Board settings
commands.description: Change the board: name, theme (light|dark), background (#rrggbb), grid (none|dot|line), gridSize (4–200), snap (snap to grid).

commands.name: view.grid
commands.label: Toggle grid
commands.description: Turn the dot grid and snapping on or off.

commands.name: view.theme
commands.label: Toggle dark board
commands.description: Switch the board between light and dark.

commands.name: view.zoom_in
commands.label: Zoom in
commands.description: Zoom in about the centre.

commands.name: view.zoom_out
commands.label: Zoom out
commands.description: Zoom out about the centre.

commands.name: view.zoom_reset
commands.label: Zoom to 100%
commands.description: Zoom to 100%.

commands.name: view.zoom_fit
commands.label: Zoom to fit all
commands.description: Zoom to show every shape.

commands.name: view.zoom_selection
commands.label: Zoom to selection
commands.description: Zoom to the selected shapes.

commands.name: view.set
commands.label: Set view
commands.description: Scroll and zoom the view: x, y (the board point at the top-left of the canvas) and zoom (0.1–30).

x.description: Board x at the left edge

y.description: Board y at the top edge

commands.name: ui.pen_only
commands.label: Pen-only mode
commands.description: In pen-only mode a stylus draws and touch only pans and zooms (I6). With no `on`, toggles.

commands.name: ui.help
commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts
commands.description: Show the keyboard shortcut sheet.

commands.name: board.new
commands.label: New board
commands.description: Start a new empty board (the current one stays in its file and its recovery copy).

commands.name: board.open
commands.label: Open
commands.description: Open a board: .chartella.json, .excalidraw, or a PNG or SVG with a board inside.

commands.name: board.save
commands.label: Save
commands.description: Save the board as a .chartella.json file (NakliOS storage when hosted, else a file you pick).

commands.name: board.export
commands.label: Export
commands.description: Export the board: format png, svg, pdf, excalidraw or chartella. pdf opens the browser's print dialog with one page per frame (or the whole page when it has no frames); choose Save as PDF there. For png and svg: scope board|selection|frame (frameId), scale 1–3, background (false: transparent), embed (true: the editable board rides inside the image, so Open brings it back). Returns { name, where, bytes } and, when returned, { mime, dataUrl }; it never opens a save picker without a click from the person.

frameId.description: Frame id when scope is frame

to.description: Where the file goes: save (NakliOS storage, or a picker or download) or return (the bytes as a data URL in the result). An agent with no click from the person gets NakliOS storage when hosted, else return

commands.name: table.set_cell
commands.label: Set table cell
commands.description: Put text in one cell of a table: row and col count from 0. Add a table with shape.add kind table, props { cells: [["a","b"],["c","d"]], colWidths, rowHeights, headerRow }.

commands.name: table.insert_row
commands.label: Insert table row
commands.description: Insert an empty row before index `at` (default: at the end).

commands.name: table.insert_col
commands.label: Insert table column
commands.description: Insert an empty column before index `at` (default: at the end).

commands.name: table.delete_row
commands.label: Delete table row
commands.description: Delete the row at index `at`.

commands.name: table.delete_col
commands.label: Delete table column
commands.description: Delete the column at index `at`.

commands.name: ui.recognize
commands.label: Sketch to shapes
commands.description: When on, a pen stroke drawn as a circle, box, triangle, diamond, line or arrow becomes that clean shape. With no `on`, toggles.

commands.name: page.add
commands.label: Add page
commands.description: Add an empty page after the others (or at index `at`) and show it. Returns { id }.

commands.name: page.select
commands.label: Go to page
commands.description: Show a page: id, or step: 1 for the next page, -1 for the previous one.

commands.name: page.rename
commands.label: Rename page
commands.description: Rename a page (default: the page on screen).

commands.name: page.move
commands.label: Reorder page
commands.description: Move a page to position `index` (from 0).

commands.name: page.duplicate
commands.label: Duplicate page
commands.description: Copy a page with everything on it (default: the page on screen). Returns { id }.

commands.name: page.delete
commands.label: Delete page
commands.description: Delete a page and everything on it (default: the page on screen). The last page cannot be deleted.

commands.name: page.move_shapes
commands.label: Move to page
commands.description: Move shapes (default: the selection) to another page; arrows that would cross pages let go.

commands.name: board.find
commands.label: Find text
commands.description: Find shapes whose text, frame name or table cells contain `query` (any case), on every page. Returns { matches: [{ id, pageId, kind, text }] }.

commands.name: ui.find
commands.label: Find on board
commands.description: Open the find bar.

commands.name: ui.layers
commands.label: Layers
commands.description: Show or hide the layers panel: frames and shapes on this page in drawing order.

commands.name: ui.minimap
commands.label: Minimap
commands.description: Show or hide the minimap.

commands.name: ui.palette
commands.label: Command palette
commands.description: Open the command palette: type to find any command and run it.

commands.name: mindmap.create
commands.label: New mind map
commands.description: Start a mind map: a rounded rectangle with `text` at x, y (default 0, 0) on the current page. Selects it. Grow it with mindmap.add_child and mindmap.add_sibling. Returns { id }.

commands.name: mindmap.add_child
commands.label: Add child node
commands.description: Add a mind-map child to a node (default: the selected shape): same kind, size and style, linked by a curved tree arrow, then lay out the tree again. Any box shape can start a mind map. Selects the new node. Returns { id }.

text.description: Text of the new node (default empty)

commands.name: mindmap.add_sibling
commands.label: Add sibling node
commands.description: Add a mind-map node just after a node (default: the selected shape), under the same parent; on the root it adds a child. Lays out the tree again and selects the new node. Returns { id }.

text.description: Text of the new node (default empty)

commands.name: layout.tree
commands.label: Tidy mind map
commands.description: Lay out the mind map holding a node (default: the selected shape) as a tidy tree from its root: dir right (default: the way it grows now) or down. The root stays put. Returns { root, moved }.

id.description: Any node of the tree (default: the selection)

commands.name: layout.graph
commands.label: Auto-layout graph
commands.description: Lay out shapes and the arrows between them as a layered graph (dagre): rankdir TB (top to bottom, default) or LR (left to right), nodesep and ranksep spacing. Default: the selection, or every shape on the current page when nothing is selected. The group keeps its top-left; elbow true turns straight arrows into elbow arrows. Returns { moved }.

ids.description: Shape ids (default: the selection, else the page)

nodesep.description: Gap between shapes in a rank (default 40)

commands.name: frame.stack
commands.label: Stack frame contents
commands.description: Make a frame lay out its contents in a row or column (dir row|column; none turns it off), with gap between shapes, padding inside the frame and align (start|center|end) across. The frame fits itself to its contents and keeps them stacked after every edit. Returns { ok }.

commands.name: stencil.list
commands.label: List shapes and icons
commands.description: List the shape libraries (flowchart, uml, devices, people, wireframe, icons) with each item's id, label and usage note. Pass `collection` for one library; the icons library is long, so prefer stencil.search for icons.

commands.name: stencil.search
commands.label: Search shapes and icons
commands.description: Find stencils and icons by name or keyword ("database", "button", "star"), best match first. Returns { matches: [{ id, label, usage, collection }] }; insert one with stencil.insert.

commands.name: stencil.insert
commands.label: Insert shape or icon
commands.description: Insert a stencil or icon by id (from stencil.list or stencil.search) with its top-left at x, y, or centred in the view when x and y are left out. w and h change its size; style sets stroke, fill, strokeWidth, dash, opacity, sketch or font. Several shapes come grouped. Selects the result. Returns { ids, groupId }.

style.description: Style overrides: stroke, fill, strokeWidth, dash, opacity, sketch, font

commands.name: board.import_mermaid
commands.label: Import Mermaid
commands.description: Turn Mermaid text into editable shapes and bound arrows on this page: flowchart (graph TD/LR, node shapes [ ] ( ) { } [( )] (( )), edge labels, subgraphs as frames) and sequence diagrams (participants, messages). Our layout places it, at x, y or the view centre. Returns { ids }.

commands.name: image.crop
commands.label: Crop image
commands.description: Crop an image (default: the selected one) to { x, y, w, h }, fractions (0..1) of the source image; null shows it whole. With no crop, opens the crop handles on the canvas.

crop.description: { x, y, w, h } fractions, or null

commands.name: image.insert_pdf_page
commands.label: Insert PDF page
commands.description: Place one page of a PDF as an image, rendered by the PDF engine Sheaf ships (available inside NakliOS). With no file, opens a picker. page counts from 1. Returns { id }.

commands.name: present.start
commands.label: Present
commands.description: Present the frames of this page one after another, full screen: arrow keys, Space and Page Down move on, Escape stops. A shape with a link jumps to its frame. Starts at frameId or the first frame.

commands.name: present.stop
commands.label: Stop presenting
commands.description: Leave presenting.

commands.name: link.set
commands.label: Link to frame
commands.description: Link shapes (default: the selection) to a frame, so a click while presenting (or Cmd/Ctrl+click while editing) goes to it; frameId null removes the link.

commands.name: link.follow
commands.label: Follow link
commands.description: Go to the frame a shape links to (default: the selected shape).

commands.name: stamp.add
commands.label: Add stamp
commands.description: Put a stamp or emoji reaction on the board at x, y (default: the view centre): emoji such as 👍 ❤️ ⭐ ✅ ❓ 🎉 🔥 👀 or any single emoji. Returns { id }.

commands.name: timer.start
commands.label: Start timer
commands.description: Start a countdown timer on screen (minutes and seconds); it chimes at zero. Starting again restarts it.

commands.name: timer.stop
commands.label: Stop timer
commands.description: Stop and hide the timer.

commands.name: template.list
commands.label: List templates
commands.description: List the board templates (kanban, retrospective, SWOT, flowchart, mind map, user journey, weekly plan) with each one's id, label, description and usage note. Insert one with template.insert.

commands.name: template.insert
commands.label: Insert template
commands.description: Insert a template by id (from template.list) with its top-left at x, y, or centred in the view when x and y are left out, on the current page. The template comes in frames named after it, so presenting walks it. Selects the result. Returns { ids }.

commands.name: ai.diagram
commands.label: Diagram from text
commands.description: Describe a flowchart, mind map or sequence and get editable shapes and bound arrows on this page. The model writes Mermaid; Chartella's own layout places it. Runs inside NakliOS on the model chosen in Settings → AI. Returns { ids }.

commands.name: ai.cluster
commands.label: Cluster stickies
commands.description: Group sticky notes (default: the selection, else every sticky on this page) by meaning: similar notes gather into coloured, named frames. With a host model, the model sorts the notes by meaning (checked JSON, every note once); without one, grouping runs on this device by shared words and keywords name the groups. Returns { groups: [{ name, ids }] }.

groups.description: How many groups (default: chosen from the notes)

commands.name: ai.summarize
commands.label: Summarize stickies
commands.description: Summarize the selected sticky notes (and text) into a new text box beside them, on the host model. Returns { id }.

commands.name: ui.chat
commands.label: Chat with the board
commands.description: Open the chat panel: ask for edits in words; the host model edits the board through these same commands, and one click undoes a whole request.

commands.name: script.run
commands.label: Run script
commands.description: Run a list of commands as one undo step: steps is [{ command, input }]. A string "$N.key" in an input is replaced by step N's result key (1-based), e.g. "$1.id". If a step fails, nothing changes. Returns { steps, results }.

errorCodes.meaning: The shape, frame, file, binding or command named does not exist.
The shape is locked; unlock it first.
There is nothing to act on.
Something must be selected or made first.
The operation does not apply to this kind of shape.
The file is not a board Chartella can read.
This browser cannot do it (an API is missing).
A colour is not in a form Chartella accepts (#rrggbb, #rgb, #rrggbbaa or transparent).
A number is outside its allowed range.
A value is not one of the allowed choices or has the wrong form.
